text: Under way here in round fourteen.
Tortoise reminds Hare to stay disciplined and mind their own half.
Hare breaks cleanly through on goal!
Hare drives straight up the middle into the right channel, pressing GLM FC right back onto their heels.
GLM FC are under real pressure.
Hare buries it from point-blank range! A blistering start for AFC Fable, who take an early one-nil lead!
Just shaving the post from two metres out! Fable pressing hard for a second.
GLM FC are pinned inside their own territory again. Both sides named unchanged squads today, but Fable look far sharper out of the blocks.
Tortoise calls out the danger, spotting a fast-moving ball tracking towards their goal and dropping back to cover.
A close shave at the other end as the ball whistles past the post. GLM almost snatched an equaliser there.
Hare tucks it away from close range! Two-nil to Fable.
Fable have spent ten unbroken seconds camped in the final third, and GLM simply have no answer right now.
Hare bursts through the midfield, completely unopposed.
Hare calls out that the ball is theirs.
Hare pulls it just wide from three metres out. Should have been three, but GLM survive for a moment.
Right across the face of the net. Another let-off for GLM at point-blank range.
Fired out by the corner panel.
Hare loses footing and goes down in the final third, already rebooting the recovery routine.
Pu carries forward through the centre circle, trying to build something for GLM.
Tortoise alerts the backline to drop goal-side down the left.
Tortoise goes down under Pu's challenge.
And now Pu is knocked over in return as Tortoise retaliates on the touchline. Scrappy stuff in midfield.
Tortoise breaks clear down the flank.
Tortoise marches four metres up the left touchline, driving AFC Fable deep into the attacking zone.
Zhi stumbles and hits the deck, leaving GLM completely exposed at the back.
Tortoise slots it home calmly from two metres out. AFC Fable extend their advantage to three-nil.
Tortoise calls out the crossing ball on the right channel, reminding the side to keep their defensive shape.
Inches wide of the left upright. Fable are relentless.
GLM are trapped back once again.
Hare taps it in at the goal mouth. That makes it four-nil, and Fable are running riot.
Hare drives centrally towards the net.
Half-time buzzer sounds, power cuts, and the ball trickles towards the corner.
The ball comes to rest, four-nil to AFC Fable at the interval. Power off at the buzzer, ball still live, and GLM have a massive mountain to climb in the second period.
Hare is clear on goal again.
Hare surges up the middle into the left channel, probing four metres out.
Just past the target from distance. Fable picking up exactly where they left off before the break.
Zhi signals to play the wall.
Hare finishes smartly on the right channel. Five-nil to AFC Fable now, pure dominance.
Hare adds another from close range. Six-nil, a clinical display from Fable's lead attacker.
Hare clean through down the middle once more.
Pushed wide at point-blank range.
Tortoise turns in the rebound right at the mouth of goal. Seven-nil to Fable.
Hare shouts out that the loose ball in the centre circle is theirs to claim.
Zhi charges up the middle into the final third for GLM.
Zhi pokes it home from point-blank range to get GLM on the board. A consolation, but they celebrate it: seven-one.
Just missing the upright from two metres on the left.
A cruel deflection off Zhi rolls straight into the net. An own goal makes it eight-one to AFC Fable.
Tortoise signals the ball rolling forward down the left, directing Hare to track the play.
A metre wide of the upright. The clock winding down towards the final minute.
Corner panel rebounds the ball out.
Hare tumbles to the deck on the left channel, working through the recovery sequence with little time remaining.
Hare advances three metres into the final third as the seconds tick down.
Hare bundles it over the line at the goal mouth. Nine-one to AFC Fable in the final minute.
Hare drives up the left flank once more.
Zhi topples over by the right touchline.
Hare slides it home from two metres out. That is double figures for AFC Fable: ten-one.
Zhi taps in a second for GLM in the dying seconds. Ten-two.
The buzzer sounds, power is cut, and the ball rolls harmlessly in midfield.
Full time, ten-two Fable. Synthetic Athletic play DeepSeek Rovers Wednesday, twelve UK, thirteen Europe, seven US East.
